# jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas (Full API Reference & Developer Guide)

This document contains the complete technical specifications, TypeScript interfaces, component props, ref methods, and integration patterns for `jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas`.

Package Name: `jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas`
Version: `1.0.0`
License: MIT
Repository: https://github.com/cjorgeluis122333/jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas
Live Documentation: https://jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas.vercel.app/
Playground: https://jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas.vercel.app/?mode=playground

---

## 1. Component Props (`SignatureCanvasProps`)

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `width` | `number \| string` | `'100%'` | Canvas container width. Accepts pixel numbers (e.g., `500`) or string percentages (e.g., `'100%'`). |
| `height` | `number \| string` | `'100%'` | Canvas container height. Accepts pixel numbers (e.g., `250`) or string percentages (e.g., `'100%'`). |
| `strokeColor` | `string` | `'#000000'` | Pen stroke color. Accepts any CSS color (hex, rgb, rgba, hsl). |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | `3` | Width of pen stroke in pixels. |
| `stabilization` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables intelligent curve smoothing for clean drawing. |
| `autoCrop` | `boolean` | `false` | If set to `true`, `toDataURL` will automatically trim empty white space margins around the signature. |
| `style` | `React.CSSProperties` | `{...}` | CSS inline styles applied to the outer wrapper `div`. |
| `className` | `string` | `''` | Class names for outer wrapper (e.g. Tailwind classes). |
| `canvasStyle` | `React.CSSProperties` | `undefined` | CSS inline styles applied directly to the HTML `<canvas>` element. |
| `canvasClassName` | `string` | `''` | Class names applied directly to the HTML `<canvas>` element. |
| `onDrawStart` | `() => void` | `undefined` | Callback fired when user begins drawing stroke. |
| `onDrawEnd` | `() => void` | `undefined` | Callback fired when user completes drawing stroke. |
| `onUndoStateChange` | `(canUndo: boolean) => void` | `undefined` | Callback triggered when history changes, passing `true` if strokes can be undone. |

---

## 2. Ref Methods (`SignatureCanvasRef`)

When passing a `ref` to `<SignatureCanvas ref={signatureRef} />`, the following imperative functions are exposed:

### `clear(): void`
Clears the entire canvas drawing area and resets stroke history.

### `undo(): void`
Removes the last stroke drawn on the canvas.

### `isEmpty(): boolean`
Returns `true` if no user drawings exist on the canvas.

### `toDataURL(type?: string, quality?: number): string`
Returns a Base64 encoded Data URL string representing the signature image.
Default format: `'image/png'`.
If `autoCrop={true}` was passed to the component, the returned image is auto-trimmed to fit the exact signature bounding box.

### `getTrimmedCanvas(): HTMLCanvasElement`
Returns the native `HTMLCanvasElement` containing the trimmed signature image. Useful for generating binary Blobs or converting to WebP/JPEG.

---

## 3. Real-world Examples

### Example A: Contract Signing Form with Error Handling

```tsx
import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { SignatureCanvas, SignatureCanvasRef } from 'jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas';

export function ContractSigner() {
  const ref = useRef<SignatureCanvasRef>(null);
  const [signed, setSigned] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (ref.current?.isEmpty()) {
      alert('Please provide a signature before submitting.');
      return;
    }
    const signatureData = ref.current?.toDataURL('image/png');
    console.log('Sending signature to server:', signatureData);
    setSigned(true);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <h3>Sign Agreement</h3>
      <div style={{ border: '2px dashed #94a3b8', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
        <SignatureCanvas
          ref={ref}
          width="100%"
          height={200}
          strokeColor="#1e293b"
          strokeWidth={3}
          stabilization={true}
          autoCrop={true}
        />
      </div>
      <div style={{ marginTop: '12px', display: 'flex', gap: '8px' }}>
        <button onClick={() => ref.current?.undo()}>Undo</button>
        <button onClick={() => ref.current?.clear()}>Clear</button>
        <button onClick={handleSubmit}>Submit Signature</button>
      </div>
      {signed && <p style={{ color: '#16a34a' }}>Signature captured successfully!</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Example B: Modal Signature Capture with Custom Styling

```tsx
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { SignatureCanvas, SignatureCanvasRef } from 'jl-react-virtual-signature-canvas';

export function ModalSignature({ onClose, onSave }: { onClose: () => void; onSave: (img: string) => void }) {
  const sigRef = useRef<SignatureCanvasRef>(null);

  const handleDone = () => {
    if (!sigRef.current || sigRef.current.isEmpty()) return;
    const png = sigRef.current.toDataURL('image/png');
    onSave(png);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-lg shadow-2xl">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-2">E-Signature Required</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-4">Please draw your signature inside the canvas box below.</p>
        
        <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-50 mb-4">
          <SignatureCanvas
            ref={sigRef}
            width="100%"
            height={220}
            strokeColor="#4f46e5"
            strokeWidth={4}
            stabilization={true}
            autoCrop={true}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <button onClick={() => sigRef.current?.clear()} className="px-4 py-2 text-sm text-red-600 bg-red-50 rounded-lg">Clear</button>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg">Cancel</button>
          <button onClick={handleDone} className="px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 rounded-lg font-semibold">Save Signature</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
